name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module
description: Provisions infrastructure from a pinned HCP Terraform no-code module in a dedicated workspace per deployment, with a plan-approval pause before apply.

name: IIS Web Application
description: Deploys a Windows server and installs an IIS web application.

name: Azure Network Security Group
description: Creates, deletes, and discovers Azure network security groups.

name: Azure Cross-Tenant Subscription
description: Creates Azure subscriptions in one tenant with billing in another, tagged to a cost center through invoice sections.

name: Windows Server with Data Disks
description: Deploys a Windows Server 2025 VM with an order-time list of data disks, attaching each one and then matching it inside the guest by serial number or SCSI address to initialize, letter, label, and format it.

name: NGINX Web Application
description: Deploys an Oracle Linux 8 server and installs an NGINX web application.

name: HCP Terraform VM
description: Provisions a VM through HCP Terraform in a dedicated workspace per deployment, with a plan-approval pause before apply.

name: Postgres Database
description: Deploys an Oracle Linux 8 server with PostgreSQL, one database, and its owning role.

name: DNS A Record
description: Creates, discovers, and removes Active Directory-integrated DNS A records over LDAPS.

name: AWS EKS Namespace
description: Creates a governed namespace on an existing EKS cluster with a tiered ResourceQuota, LimitRange, and default-deny NetworkPolicies, and entitles the ordering group to deploy containers into it.

name: Run Aria Orchestrator Workflow
description: Runs an Aria Orchestrator workflow as a CloudBolt resource build, stores the workflow outputs on the resource, and runs it again with teardown parameters on delete.

name: Server with Data Disks
description: Deploys a Windows Server or Oracle Linux VM whose order form turns the environment's disk_map parameter into a table of data disks, which the disk map orchestration actions attach and prepare inside the guest.

name: Run an Azure PowerShell Script
description: Runs one of a catalog of Azure PowerShell Remote Scripts against the Azure subscription of a chosen Environment on a Windows host you manage (the script's Run on Server), with the sign-in handled by CloudBolt from the environment's resource handler.

name: Request Certificate (Windows CA)
description: Requests a certificate from a Microsoft AD CS certificate authority through Web Enrollment and stores the issued PEM on the resource.

name: Create VPC
description: Creates an AWS VPC with an Ansible playbook and a matching CloudBolt environment.

name: Bicep Deployment
description: Deploys an Azure deployment stack from a Bicep template hosted in GitHub, with a what-if preview and approval gate.

name: Azure Storage Account
description: Creates, deletes, and discovers Azure storage accounts, with day-2 actions for SKU, access tier, and blob containers.

name: Azure Resource Group - Bicep
description: Creates an Azure resource group from Microsoft's subscription-scoped create-rg Bicep quickstart template as a deployment stack.

name: Windows File Server
description: Deploys a Windows server and installs the File Server role.

name: Run an Azure PowerShell Script (Deployment Script)
description: Runs one of a catalog of Azure PowerShell Remote Scripts against the Azure subscription of a chosen Environment in a Microsoft-managed container started per run through an ARM deployment script, with no server to maintain and the sign-in handled by CloudBolt from the environment's resource handler.

name: AWS EKS
description: Creates, deletes, and discovers Amazon EKS clusters, with day-2 actions to add, list, scale, upgrade, and delete managed node groups, update add-ons, upgrade the control plane's Kubernetes version, and create namespace landing zones.

name: Oracle Linux Server with Data Disks
description: Deploys an Oracle Linux VM with an order-time list of data disks, attaching each one and then matching it inside the guest by serial number or SCSI address to create an LVM volume, format it XFS, and mount it.

name: Migrate Aria Automation Projects to Groups
description: Migrates Aria Automation projects to CloudBolt groups with their AD group role assignments and custom properties.

name: OpenShift Project Landing Zone
description: Creates a governed OpenShift project with quota, limits, and network isolation, and entitles the ordering group to deploy into it.

name: HCP Terraform No-Code + Ansible
description: Provisions infrastructure from a pinned HCP Terraform no-code module in a dedicated workspace per deployment, with a plan-approval pause before apply, then runs the pinned Ansible job templates on the deployment's servers.

name: VM with Workflow
description: Deploys a Windows Server or Oracle Linux VM and then runs a workflow on it, either one the order form offers or one an admin pins on the Run Workflow build item.

name: POC Server
description: Deploys one server into any environment, runs a Hello World script inside the guest (Bash on Linux, PowerShell on Windows) and asks for an application tier whose options come from Python, covering the POC test plan's post-provisioning, in-guest scripting and generated-options items.

name: Azure Resource Group
description: Creates, deletes, and discovers Azure resource groups, with day-2 actions for tags, delete locks, and contents.

name: Migrate Aria Automation Deployments to Resources
description: Migrates the deployments of one Aria Automation cloud template into CloudBolt resources under the matching blueprint, with owners, groups, environments, and custom properties.

name: Azure NSG Management
description: Adds a Security Rules tab to Azure network security group resources for viewing and editing inbound and outbound rules.

name: Io Cloudbolt Prometheus
description: Adds a Prometheus-backed Monitoring server tab and a service-discovery endpoint that lists servers tagged monitor.

name: Azure Patches
description: Adds a Patching server tab to Azure VMs that shows the latest patch assessment and runs scan and apply jobs.

name: AWS EKS Cluster
description: Adds Cluster, Node groups, and Workloads tabs to AWS EKS cluster resources with live cluster and add-on status, a Kubernetes upgrade banner, node group scaling and deletion, and per-node and per-namespace workload figures, and Connect and Workloads tabs to Kubernetes namespace landing zones with kubectl access details and a live inventory.

name: HCP Terraform Workspace
description: Adds Terraform and Terraform Variables tabs to HCP Terraform resources with the workspace summary, no-code module name and version with an update-available notice, drift and cost estimate, run history with CloudBolt job links, a pending-run discard, managed resources, and read-only variables.

name: Openscap
description: Adds an OpenSCAP server tab for Enterprise Linux servers that runs profile scans and collects the HTML reports.

name: Content Package Manager
description: Adds a Content Packages admin page for defining named sets of blueprints, actions, plugins, shared modules, UI extensions, and standalone parameters, and for exporting, syncing, or importing each set through CloudBolt's own per-object repository push and sync.

name: Runbooks
description: Adds a Runbooks admin page with three tabs: Workflows, for building ordered runs of CloudBolt actions with filters, fixed or prompted inputs and outputs passed between steps; Actions, for creating Remote Scripts and plug-ins and seeing where each base action is used; and File Archives, for versioned files that scripts download through short-lived signed links.

name: Ssm Inventory
description: Adds Inventory and Patching server tabs for EC2 instances managed by AWS Systems Manager.

name: Technology Reference
description: Adds a read-only Technology Reference tab to Resource Handler and Environment pages listing the technology's custom fields, actions, and field dependencies, discovered live from the instance and exportable as one .xlsx.

name: Io Cloudbolt Widgets
description: Adds nine dashboard widgets covering server counts, cloud availability, and other operational summaries.

name: dataDiskMapForm
description: Async form function that turns an environment's disk_map parameter into a Data Disks table whose columns follow the selected OS build, writing the rows back to disk_map as a JSON list.

name: runbookWorkflowItems
description: Async form function for blueprint custom forms with Run Workflow build items: replaces each item's Workflow inputs box with a panel of the chosen or pinned workflow's prompts and writes the answers back as the item's input.

name: runbookWorkflowForm
description: Async form function for the Run Workflow form: loads the chosen workflow's steps and prompts into the Dynamic Panel and offers to save credentials on a VM that has none, without putting the password in the submitted form.

name: runbookTaskForm
description: Async form function for the Run Task form: loads the chosen task's inputs into the Dynamic Panel and offers to save credentials on a VM that has none, without putting the password in the submitted form.

name: azpsBuildScriptPanel
description: Async form function shared by the order forms of the two Azure PowerShell blueprints (the build-item prefix is its optional second argument): fetches the chosen script's input fields from the azps-script-panel webhook and installs them as the Script Parameters Dynamic Panel's template, resolving instantly on re-evaluation while the panel already matches the chosen script.

name: dataDiskLetterFree
description: Form function for the Windows Server with Data Disks order form: hides a drive letter in a Data Disks row once another row uses it.

name: tfcBuildDay2Panel
description: Async form function for the shared Terraform Update form: fetches the resource's variables panel from the form-options webhook and installs it as the empty Dynamic Panel's template.

name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module
description: Provisions an HCP Terraform no-code module; the job pauses for plan review before apply.

name: Oracle Linux Server with Data Disks
description: Deploys an Oracle Linux VM with the data disks you list below, each turned into an LVM volume with an XFS file system and mounted inside the guest.

name: Server with Data Disks
description: Deploys a Windows Server or Oracle Linux VM with the data disks you list, each prepared inside the guest.

name: Bicep Deployment
description: Deploys an Azure deployment stack from a Bicep template hosted in GitHub after a what-if preview and approval.

name: Run Task
description: Run one of the tasks that fit this VM: pick a task, fill in its inputs, and submit.

name: HCP Terraform No-Code + Ansible
description: Provisions an HCP Terraform no-code module and runs the pinned Ansible job templates on its servers; the job pauses for plan review before apply.

name: Run Workflow
description: Run one of the workflows that fit this VM: pick a workflow, fill in what it asks for, and submit.

name: Terraform Update
description: Edit this deployment's Terraform variables. The change is planned in its HCP Terraform workspace and the job pauses for plan review; Continue Job applies it, canceling the job discards the run and restores the previous values.

name: Migrate Aria Automation Deployments to Resources
description: Migrates the deployments of one Aria Automation cloud template into CloudBolt resources under the matching blueprint, with owners, groups, environments, and custom properties.

name: Azure Resource Group - Bicep
description: Creates an Azure resource group from Microsoft's create-rg Bicep quickstart template after a what-if preview and approval.

name: VM with Workflow
description: Deploys a Windows Server or Oracle Linux VM, then runs the workflow you pick on it.

name: Windows Server with Data Disks
description: Deploys a Windows Server 2025 VM with the data disks you list below, each initialized, lettered, labeled, and formatted inside the guest.

name: Run an Azure PowerShell Script
description: Runs one of this blueprint's Azure PowerShell scripts against the Azure subscription behind the Environment you choose. CloudBolt signs the session in; no credentials are entered here.

name: Run an Azure PowerShell Script (Deployment Script)
description: Runs one of this blueprint's Azure PowerShell scripts against the Azure subscription behind the Environment you choose, in a container Azure starts for the run. CloudBolt signs the session in; no credentials are entered here.

name: HCP Terraform VM
description: Provisions a VM through HCP Terraform in a dedicated workspace and pauses for plan review before apply.

name: POC Onboarding: Tag Mapping
description: Lists, adds or removes a resource handler's mappings from CloudBolt attributes or parameters to cloud tags, giving cross-cloud tagging and the cost-center tag.

name: POC Onboarding: Import OS Build
description: Lists a handler's cached images for a location or imports one (AWS AMI, Azure marketplace image, vCenter template) into an OS build, reusing a build of the same name so one build spans handlers, refreshing an empty cache without the whitelist, and attaching the build to the environments.

name: POC Onboarding: Status
description: Reports the appliance's POC readiness in one read: licence, portal, SMTP, proxy, Content Library, Setup Wizard, resource handlers with environments and last verify result, the Custom Server blueprint, groups, users, LDAP, SSO, installed onboarding tools, recorded POC items, and the next steps with UI links.

name: POC Onboarding: Environment Networks
description: Lists the networks an environment can offer on its first NIC and makes the chosen ones, up to five, its only NIC 1 choices, removing networks from every other NIC.

name: Sync From Source Control Repo
description: Creates a Source Control Repository sync job for the given branch and content paths so an agent can import or refresh content it pushed, and returns the job id to poll.

name: POC Onboarding: Install
description: Finishes the toolkit install after a sync or package import: sets Synchronous Action on the inline tools, enables every tool, checks outbound access to the Content Library and GitHub, and records the toolkit version.

name: POC Onboarding: Parameter
description: Creates or updates a parameter and attaches it to environments and groups with options and constraints, covering the test plan's user-defined parameter, cost-center tag source, power schedule and expiration date with a maximum lease.

name: POC Onboarding: Handler Locations
description: Lists the regions, locations or clusters a resource handler can turn into environments, flags the ones already imported, lists the existing environments, and for an AWS region lists its VPCs.

name: POC Onboarding: SMTP Settings
description: Sets the non-secret email settings and returns the link where the SMTP password is entered; with no inputs it reports the current settings.

name: Fetch Job Log
description: Returns a job's status, output, errors, progress log, child jobs, failed descendants, and sync results in one call so a failed job can be diagnosed.

name: POC Onboarding: Playbook
description: Returns a section of the POC onboarding skill text from the public cloudbolt-as-code repository, so MCP clients without skill support follow the same procedure.

name: Run Blueprint Discovery
description: Launches the Sync Resources job for one blueprint so its discovery plugin runs on demand.

name: Compare Azure List Prices
description: Looks up Azure public list prices for any service across the regions of the Azure environments the caller can order into, with monthly estimates and hints for refining the search.

name: POC Onboarding: Action Approval
description: Turns Requires approval on or off for a server or resource action, which the API cannot change, so a day-2 action pauses as an order for an approver.

name: POC Onboarding: CIT Test from Order
description: Turns a finished blueprint order into a Continuous Infrastructure Testing test, the same as the order page's Add to CIT action.

name: POC Onboarding: Group
description: Creates or updates a group with its parent, entitled environments, auto-approval flag and server-count quota, covering the test plan's entitlement, approval and quota items.

name: POC Onboarding: LDAP Mapping
description: Maps an AD or LDAP group DN to a CloudBolt group with roles on an existing LDAP utility, so directory users land in the right group at first login.

name: Run CIT Tests
description: Starts a functionaltest job for the named CIT tests and returns its job id.

name: POC Onboarding: Recent Errors
description: Reads the tail of a CloudBolt log and returns the recent WARNING-and-above entries grouped by exception and message, secrets redacted, each group with a hint for the failures a new appliance hits most.

name: POC Onboarding: Configure Custom Server
description: Makes the shipped Custom Server blueprint orderable for the POC: recreates it when missing, activates it, enables every environment on its server tier, and sets a hostname template on the tier or on the listed environments.

name: POC Onboarding: Import Environments
description: Creates one environment per listed location on a resource handler the way the Import locations dialog does, brings the networks over (AWS subnets with the environment, Azure subnets synced; vCenter networks are chosen afterwards with onb_environment_networks), and reports existing environments instead of duplicating them.

name: POC Onboarding: Trim Environment Order Form
description: Shortens an environment's order form for a POC by pinning infrastructure parameters to one value (which hides a required field) and removing the optional technology parameters, leaving the size, the NIC 1 networks chosen with onb_environment_networks and, where needed, the password; the report profile only lists the current form.

name: Cancel Jobs
description: Sets the named jobs and their unfinished descendants to TO_CANCEL, like the jobs cancel endpoint.

name: POC Onboarding: Failure Trace
description: Walks an order or job down to the jobs that actually failed and returns their errors, output, progress tail, failed children and a hint for the common provisioning failures, naming the job id to pass to fetch_job_log for the traceback.

name: POC Onboarding: Verify LDAP
description: Runs an LDAP utility's Verify Connection and returns the real bind or search error with a hint and the links to fix it.

name: Order Counts by Blueprint
description: Return the number of orders placed for each blueprint, optionally filtered by order status.

name: Manage Blueprint Permissions
description: Lists, grants, or revokes a group's DEPLOY or MANAGE permission on a blueprint, so a repository sync's loss of group permissions can be snapshotted and restored.

name: POC Onboarding: Set Item Status
description: Records a POC test plan item or prerequisite as done, skipped, not applicable or pending with a reason, in a namespaced CustomField store that onb_status and the scorecard read.

name: POC Onboarding: Sync Images
description: Fills a resource handler's image cache now without the image whitelist and enables the recurring job and rule that keep it fresh, so the image pickers and onb_import_os_build see every image the credentials can.

name: POC Onboarding: Remove Environment
description: Deletes an environment imported by mistake so the POC can start over; refuses while active servers live in it.

name: POC Onboarding: SMTP Test
description: Sends a test email through the saved SMTP settings and returns the relay's real error with a hint when it fails.

name: POC Onboarding: Verify Resource Handler
description: Runs a resource handler's Verify Connection and returns the real exception text with a technology-specific hint, the minimum-permissions document and the handler's edit and verify links, recording the result for the status tool.

name: Run Recurring Job
description: Runs a recurring job immediately, like Run Now on the Recurring Jobs page.

name: POC Onboarding: User
description: Creates a local user with no usable password and assigns roles in a group, returning the edit link where the admin sets the password; an existing user only gets the roles.

name: POC Onboarding: Network Addressing
description: Sets how servers on a network get their IP address (DHCP, static with gateway and netmask, a CloudBolt IP pool, an IPAM endpoint, or an IP typed per order) and verifies it with the network's IP provider.

name: POC Onboarding: Scorecard
description: Builds the POC test plan scorecard from the recorded item statuses and live evidence on the appliance (orders, handlers, environments, groups, mappings, actions, jobs), per category with weights.

name: POC Onboarding: Install Content Library Item
description: Lists a Content Library collection or downloads one item from content.cloudbolt.app and imports it the way the library page does, for UI extensions, recurring jobs, server and resource actions, rules and blueprints.

name: POC Onboarding: UI Link
description: Turns a CloudBolt global id or a named admin page (new resource handler per technology, LDAP, SMTP, user edit, environment parameters, group quotas, and more) into an absolute UI link so the agent can send the user to the exact page where a secret is entered or an object is edited.

name: Suggest Domain OUs
description: Turns the domain_ou parameter into a type-ahead that lists Active Directory OUs matching the typed text anywhere in their path once the user types three characters.

name: Add Parent Blueprints to Group
description: Grants a newly created group explicit deploy permission on every blueprint that one of its ancestor groups is explicitly permitted to deploy, at Post Group Creation.

name: Generate options for 'POC Application Tier'
description: Fills the POC Application Tier order-form parameter from Python with web, app and db, dropping db for production groups.

name: Configure Data Disks from Disk Map (Windows)
description: At Post-Provision, formats the disks from each Windows server's disk_map inside the guest with their drive letters and NTFS labels.

name: Configure Data Disks from Disk Map (Oracle Linux)
description: At Post-Provision, turns the disks from each Oracle Linux server's disk_map into LVM volumes with XFS file systems mounted at their mount points inside the guest.

name: Generate options for Ansible job template maps
description: Lists the Variable Maps that are Ansible job template maps so an admin pins a blueprint's ansible_job_template_maps parameter from a dropdown.

name: AD DNS - Create A Record
description: Registers an AD-integrated DNS A record for each provisioned server at Post-Provision.

name: AD DNS - Delete A Record
description: Tombstones the AD-integrated DNS A record CloudBolt registered for each server at Pre-Delete.

name: ServiceNow Request: Close on Completion
description: Closes the order's ServiceNow RITM when every job of the order has finished and attaches the CIs of the servers it produced.

name: Azure CMK - Remove Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
description: Removes the per-VM disk encryption set, key-access grant, and Key Vault key at Post-Delete after an Azure VM is destroyed.

name: ServiceNow Request: Open on Submit
description: Opens the ServiceNow REQ/RITM when an order is submitted, making ServiceNow the approval system of record for that order.

name: ServiceNow Request: Close on Denial
description: Closes the order's ServiceNow RITM as incomplete when a CloudBolt approver denies the order.

name: Join Windows Server to AD Domain
description: Joins newly provisioned Windows servers to their Active Directory domain at Post-Provision.

name: Attach Data Disks from Disk Map
description: At Post-Provision, adds the data disks in each server's disk_map parameter through its resource handler and records each disk's controller, SCSI address, and serial for the in-guest step.

name: Join Linux Server to AD Domain
description: Joins newly provisioned Linux servers to their Active Directory domain at Post-Provision.

name: Delete Windows Computer Object from AD
description: Deletes the Active Directory computer object of each Windows server being deleted at Pre-Delete.

name: Generate options for 'Expiration Date'
description: Pre-fills the Expiration Date order-form parameter with a default of seven days from now.

name: ServiceNow Request: Open on Approval
description: At Post-Order Approval, holds every order subject to ServiceNow until ServiceNow approves it, opening the REQ/RITM first for orders CloudBolt auto-approved; with the wait pin off, opens a record-only RITM instead.

name: Generate options for HCP Terraform coordinates
description: Lists HCP Terraform connections, organizations, projects and no-code modules so an admin pins a no-code blueprint's coordinates from dropdowns.

name: Azure Resource Manager Rate Hook
description: Computes Azure server rates from negotiated Price Sheet prices, falling back to public retail prices.

name: Azure NSG - Attach VM to NSG
description: Attaches each provisioned Azure VM to the network security group selected on the order form at Post-Provision.

name: Azure CMK - Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
description: Encrypts each provisioned Azure VM's disks with a per-VM customer-managed key and disk encryption set at Post-Provision.

name: HCP Terraform
description: Provisions VMs and no-code modules through HCP Terraform in a workspace per deployment, optionally followed by Ansible job templates, with their day-2 actions, the form options webhook, and the UI extension that adds Terraform tabs.

name: POC Onboarding Toolkit
description: Installs the MCP tools the POC onboarding skill drives (appliance status with next steps, admin UI links, log and failure diagnosis, resource handler verification, image cache sync and location import, environment creation, order-form trimming, OS build import, environment networks and their addressing (DHCP, static, IP pool, IPAM), Custom Server setup, parameters, groups, users, action approval, tag and LDAP mappings, SMTP, Content Library installs, CIT tests from orders, the scorecard, the playbook text, the install step and POC item tracking), the repository sync, job log and blueprint permission tools they reuse, and the POC Server blueprint and echo webhook that cover the test plan's scripting, generated-options and webhook items.

name: AWS EKS
description: Provisions AWS EKS clusters and namespace landing zones with their day-2 actions and the UI extension that adds cluster and namespace tabs.

name: Windows AD Domain Join
description: Joins provisioned Windows servers to Active Directory in the OU picked from a type-ahead domain_ou parameter, taking the domain and its LDAP Utility from the OU, and deletes the computer object at decommission.

name: Data Disk Blueprints
description: Deploys Windows Server and Oracle Linux VMs with order-time data disks through the Windows, Oracle Linux, and disk map blueprints, with the Post-Provision orchestration actions that attach the disk map's disks and prepare them inside the guest.

name: Runbooks
description: Adds Run Task and Run Workflow, actions that run any Remote Script that fits a VM or an ordered workflow of CloudBolt actions on it, with base, example and installer task scripts, the Runbooks page for building workflows, base actions and file archives, and an example blueprint that runs a workflow.

name: Data Disks from a Disk Map
description: Adds order-time data disks to Windows Server and Oracle Linux VMs through an environment disk_map parameter, a form function that turns it into a disk table, and Post-Provision orchestration actions that attach the disks and prepare them inside the guest.

name: Domain OU
description: Specific OU to join the domain. Will only be used if the 'Domain to Join' is specified.

name: Data Disks
description: Data disks to add to the server, as a JSON list: one entry per disk with drive_letter (Windows) or mount_point (Linux), size_gb, and volume_name.

name: Manage Windows Service
description: Shows, starts, stops or restarts one Windows service by its service name and prints its state afterwards.

name: POC Onboarding: Handler Locations
description: Lists the regions, locations or clusters a resource handler can turn into environments, flags the ones already imported, lists the existing environments, and for an AWS region lists its VPCs.

name: Install IIS Windows
description: Installs IIS on a Windows server.

name: POC Onboarding: Environment Networks
description: Lists the networks an environment can offer on its first NIC and makes the chosen ones, up to five, its only NIC 1 choices, removing networks from every other NIC.

name: Sync From Source Control Repo
description: Creates a Source Control Repository sync job for the given branch and content paths so an agent can import or refresh content it pushed, and returns the job id to poll.

name: POC Onboarding: Playbook
description: Returns a section of the POC onboarding skill text from the public cloudbolt-as-code repository, so MCP clients without skill support follow the same procedure.

name: POC Onboarding: UI Link
description: Turns a CloudBolt global id or a named admin page (new resource handler per technology, LDAP, SMTP, user edit, environment parameters, group quotas, and more) into an absolute UI link so the agent can send the user to the exact page where a secret is entered or an object is edited.

name: Attach Data Disks (Windows)
description: Adds one virtual disk per row of the order form's Data Disks table to each Windows server and records on its data_disk_layout parameter what the guest uses to find each disk, through the per-handler providers in the data_disk_mapping shared module.

name: Set URL Parameter
description: Sets the website URL parameter on the web application resource.

name: POC Onboarding: Remove Environment
description: Deletes an environment imported by mistake so the POC can start over; refuses while active servers live in it.

name: Install Postgres
description: Installs PostgreSQL on an Oracle Linux 8 server.

name: Teardown HCP Terraform VM
description: Destroys the HCP Terraform workspace behind a VM deployment with a destroy run and a safe workspace delete.

name: Initialize Windows Disk
description: Initializes, partitions, and formats newly attached raw disks in a Windows guest.

name: Cancel Jobs
description: Sets the named jobs and their unfinished descendants to TO_CANCEL, like the jobs cancel endpoint.

name: Fetch Job Log
description: Returns a job's status, output, errors, progress log, child jobs, failed descendants, and sync results in one call so a failed job can be diagnosed.

name: Install NGINX OEL8
description: Installs NGINX on an Oracle Linux 8 server.

name: Azure CMK - Remove Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
description: Deletes the per-VM disk encryption set, revokes its key grant, and soft-deletes the key recorded on a decommissioned Azure server.

name: Manage AWS EKS Namespace Access
description: Grants or revokes kubectl access to an EKS namespace for an IAM role or user through a namespace-scoped EKS access entry, and a CloudBolt group's entitlement to its environment.

name: Delete AWS EKS Nodegroup
description: Deletes a chosen managed node group from the EKS cluster, waits for AWS to finish, and removes its sub-resource.

name: Run Aria Orchestrator Workflow
description: Runs an Aria Orchestrator workflow with Django-rendered parameters, waits for it to finish, and writes its outputs onto the resource as custom fields; the same plugin runs again on teardown.

name: List Blob Containers
description: Lists the blob containers in the resource's Azure storage account.

name: Extend Expiration
description: Extends a landing-zone project's expiration date on the resource and the namespace annotation.

name: POC Onboarding: Recent Errors
description: Reads the tail of a CloudBolt log and returns the recent WARNING-and-above entries grouped by exception and message, secrets redacted, each group with a hint for the failures a new appliance hits most.

name: Run SQL Command
description: Runs a SQL command against the PostgreSQL server.

name: Teardown Azure Resource Group
description: Deletes the Azure resource group behind the resource, refusing while a management lock is present.

name: Deploy Latest Version
description: Upgrades an HCP Terraform no-code deployment's workspace to the module version pinned in HCP Terraform with a plan-approval pause; a no-op when already current, and runs on every selected resource in a bulk action.

name: Set VPC Name
description: Renames the resource to the VPC name returned by the Ansible playbook.

name: Generate options for HCP Terraform coordinates
description: Generates the dropdown choices an admin pins a no-code blueprint's HCP Terraform connection, organization, project and module from, each list narrowed by the pins before it.

name: POC Onboarding: Set Item Status
description: Records a POC test plan item or prerequisite as done, skipped, not applicable or pending with a reason, in a namespaced CustomField store that onb_status and the scorecard read.

name: Teardown Azure Subscription
description: Cancels the Azure subscription, which can be reactivated within 90 days.

name: Expire Servers
description: Finds expired servers and runs the configured expiration orchestration action on them.

name: Deploy AWS App Migration Agent
description: Installs the AWS Application Migration Service replication agent on a Linux server.

name: Manage Linux Service
description: Shows, starts, stops or restarts one systemd unit and prints its state afterwards.

name: POC Onboarding: Status
description: Reports the appliance's POC readiness in one read: licence, portal, SMTP, proxy, Content Library, Setup Wizard, resource handlers with environments and last verify result, the Custom Server blueprint, groups, users, LDAP, SSO, installed onboarding tools, recorded POC items, and the next steps with UI links.

name: Request Certificate (Windows CA)
description: Submits a generated or supplied CSR to a Microsoft AD CS certificate authority and stores the issued PEM certificate.

name: Run Workflow
description: Runs a workflow in order on the selected VMs, for the Run Workflow action or as a blueprint build item on the VMs an order deployed, after checking the workflow, every step and every input against each VM.

name: Azure Network Security Group Build
description: Creates an Azure network security group.

name: Azure Resource Group
description: Creates an Azure resource group in the selected environment's subscription and region with generated and order-form tags.

name: URL Connectivity Check
description: Probes the URLs entered on the job and reports which CA each presents and whether it passes under CloudBolt's current SSL setting and with verification forced on.

name: Generate options for Ansible job template maps
description: Generates the dropdown choices an admin pins a blueprint's ansible_job_template_maps parameter from: every Variable Map on the instance whose JSON has a job_template key, labeled with the AAP job template it launches.

name: AWS EKS Namespace Connection Details
description: Shows the commands that connect kubectl to an EKS namespace and which IAM roles and users have access to it.

name: Migrate Aria Automation Deployments
description: Imports the deployments of one Aria Automation cloud template as CloudBolt resources or stand-alone servers, matching VMs by instance UUID and carrying over owner, group, environment, and custom properties.

name: POC Hello World (Linux)
description: Prints a hello message, the host name and the user inside a Linux guest to prove agentless script execution.

name: POC Onboarding: User
description: Creates a local user with no usable password and assigns roles in a group, returning the edit link where the admin sets the password; an existing user only gets the roles.

name: POC Onboarding: Import Environments
description: Creates one environment per listed location on a resource handler the way the Import locations dialog does, brings the networks over (AWS subnets with the environment, Azure subnets synced; vCenter networks are chosen afterwards with onb_environment_networks), and reports existing environments instead of duplicating them.

name: Teardown Azure Storage Account
description: Deletes the Azure storage account behind the resource.

name: Remove Servers from Ansible Automation Platform
description: Removes the host records a deployment's servers hold in Ansible Automation Platform inventories through CloudBolt's own connector method, before the infrastructure is destroyed; a missing host or unreachable AAP is a warning, never a blocker.

name: Build Azure Subscription
description: Creates an Azure subscription with cross-tenant billing.

name: Node Size - Generate Options by OS Build Architecture
description: Generates node_size options limited to sizes matching the selected OS build's processor architecture.

name: Runbook Workflows
description: Serves the Run Workflow form: the workflows that fit a VM, a chosen workflow's steps and prompts, and saving credentials on a VM that has none.

name: Update Bicep Deployment
description: Updates a Bicep deployment stack with changed parameters after a what-if preview and approval.

name: Configure Data Disks from Disk Map (Oracle Linux)
description: Prepares the disks from a Linux server's disk_map in the guest: matches each one by serial number, SCSI address, or attach order, then creates an LVM volume with an XFS file system and mounts it.

name: Network Security Group Teardown
description: Deletes the Azure network security group behind the resource.

name: Drift Check
description: Reports drift between a Bicep deployment stack and its template with a read-only what-if.

name: Join Windows Server to AD Domain
description: Joins a Windows server with Add-Computer to the Active Directory OU its domain_ou names under its CloudBolt hostname, renaming the guest when needed, then waits for the restart and verifies the name and secure channel.

name: Resize
description: Resizes an HCP Terraform VM by updating the vm_size variable and running with a plan-approval pause.

name: Manage Team Access
description: Grants or revokes team access to a landing-zone project through CloudBolt group entitlement or an OpenShift role binding.

name: Azure PS - Tag Resource Group
description: Merges one tag onto a named resource group in the selected environment's Azure subscription and prints the resulting tags.

name: Request AWS EKS Namespace Quota Change
description: Moves an EKS namespace landing zone to a different size tier after approval and mirrors the new quota into its environment.

name: Discover Azure Subscriptions
description: Discovers Azure subscriptions visible to each Azure resource handler's service principal.

name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module
description: Provisions infrastructure from a pinned HCP Terraform no-code module into a chosen CloudBolt environment's Azure subscription, with a plan-approval pause before apply.

name: Discover HCP Terraform No-Code Workspaces
description: Syncs the no-code blueprint's resources with the HCP Terraform workspaces created from its pinned module: refreshes module version, update flag, latest run, outputs and variables, onboards unmanaged workspaces, and retires deleted ones.

name: Bicep Engine Connectivity Check
description: Probes every host the Bicep engine needs and reports which CA each presents and whether it passes under CloudBolt's current SSL setting and with verification forced on.

name: Apply Public-Exposure Policy
description: Assigns the CloudBolt public-exposure Azure Policy initiative to the subscription.

name: POC Onboarding: Tag Mapping
description: Lists, adds or removes a resource handler's mappings from CloudBolt attributes or parameters to cloud tags, giving cross-cloud tagging and the cost-center tag.

name: POC Onboarding: Sync Images
description: Fills a resource handler's image cache now without the image whitelist and enables the recurring job and rule that keep it fresh, so the image pickers and onb_import_os_build see every image the credentials can.

name: POC Onboarding: SMTP Settings
description: Sets the non-secret email settings and returns the link where the SMTP password is entered; with no inputs it reports the current settings.

name: Runbook Tasks
description: Serves the Run Task form: the tasks that fit a VM, a chosen task's inputs, and saving credentials on a VM that has none.

name: Add AWS EKS Nodegroup
description: Creates a managed node group on the EKS cluster with the chosen AMI type, instance type, disk size, and scaling bounds, and records it as a sub-resource.

name: Azure Price Sheet Refresh
description: Downloads each Azure handler's negotiated Price Sheet and caches it on disk for the rate hook.

name: Delete Windows Computer Object from AD
description: Deletes a Windows server's Active Directory computer object over LDAP with the LDAP Utility for its domain, matching it by the objectGUID recorded at join or, failing that, by a name created after the server.

name: Teardown AWS EKS Namespace
description: Deletes the EKS namespace and everything in it, waits for it to terminate, then removes the pinned CloudBolt environment.

name: ServiceNow Request Approval Sync
description: Approves or denies pending CloudBolt orders to match the approval recorded on their ServiceNow RITM, and closes the RITM of orders cancelled in CloudBolt.

name: Azure PS Script Panel
description: Serves the Run an Azure PowerShell Script order form the SurveyJS fields for the chosen catalog script's declared action inputs, built from CloudBolt's own parameter metadata.

name: Generate options for 'Expiration Date'
description: Returns an initial Expiration Date value of seven days from now.

name: Run Ansible Job Templates on Servers
description: Launches the Ansible Automation Platform job templates declared by the job template maps (Variable Maps with a job_template key) pinned on the blueprint's ansible_job_template_maps parameter for every server of the deployment, building each template's extra vars from CloudBolt data with Django templates and never adding the host to an inventory; no pinned maps or no servers is a no-op.

name: AD DNS - Create A Record
description: Creates an AD-integrated DNS A record for each provisioned server over LDAPS and records its identity for teardown.

name: DNS Record - Build
description: Creates an AD-integrated DNS A record from order-form inputs over LDAPS.

name: AD DNS - Delete A Record
description: Tombstones the AD-integrated DNS A record recorded on each decommissioned server.

name: DNS Record - Discover
description: Discovers AD-integrated DNS A records across all configured LDAP utilities.

name: DNS Record - Teardown
description: Tombstones the AD-integrated DNS A record created by the resource.

name: Run Blueprint Discovery
description: Launches the Sync Resources job for one blueprint so its discovery plugin runs on demand.

name: Discover Azure Resource Groups
description: Discovers Azure resource groups across all Azure resource handlers, including tags and lock state.

name: Discover OpenShift Project Landing Zones
description: Discovers landing-zone projects across all OpenShift Virtualization resource handlers.

name: Discover EKS
description: Discovers EKS clusters in every AWS environment and creates or updates a CloudBolt resource and Kubernetes container orchestrator for each.

name: Configure Data Disks (Windows)
description: Matches each attached data disk to its Windows disk by serial number, LUN, SCSI target, or attach order, then initializes it GPT and formats it NTFS with the requested drive letter and label.

name: POC Onboarding: Group
description: Creates or updates a group with its parent, entitled environments, auto-approval flag and server-count quota, covering the test plan's entitlement, approval and quota items.

name: Upgrade AWS EKS Nodegroup
description: Updates a managed node group to the cluster's Kubernetes version or the latest AMI release for its current version, waits for EKS to replace the nodes, and refreshes the sub-resource.

name: Join Linux Server to AD Domain
description: Joins a Linux server to Active Directory with realmd, SSSD, and adcli using its LDAP utility's credentials.

name: Update AWS EKS Add-on
description: Updates one EKS add-on to a newer version published for the cluster's Kubernetes version and waits for AWS to finish.

name: Generate options for 'POC Application Tier'
description: Fills the POC Application Tier dropdown from Python (web, app, db), dropping the database tier for production groups, to show Python-backed parameter options.

name: POC Onboarding: Parameter
description: Creates or updates a parameter and attaches it to environments and groups with options and constraints, covering the test plan's user-defined parameter, cost-center tag source, power schedule and expiration date with a maximum lease.

name: Change SKU
description: Changes the replication SKU of the Azure storage account.

name: Form Options
description: Serves custom-form dropdown options scoped to a CloudBolt Environment or an HCP Terraform no-code module, and builds a deployed resource's Terraform Update variables panel.

name: POC Onboarding: Network Addressing
description: Sets how servers on a network get their IP address (DHCP, static with gateway and netmask, a CloudBolt IP pool, an IPAM endpoint, or an IP typed per order) and verifies it with the network's IP provider.

name: Deploy Bicep Template
description: Deploys an Azure deployment stack from a GitHub-hosted Bicep template after a what-if preview and approval.

name: Migrate Aria Automation Projects
description: Creates a CloudBolt group for each selected Aria Automation project, maps the project's AD group role assignments to CloudBolt roles through LDAP mappings, and copies its unencrypted custom properties as group parameters.

name: Discover Azure Storage Accounts
description: Discovers Azure storage accounts across all Azure resource handlers.

name: Manage AWS EKS Namespace Pipeline Identity
description: Creates or deletes an IAM role that a GitHub Actions workflow assumes through OIDC, with kubectl access to an EKS namespace through an access entry.

name: Run Installer from File Archive (Linux)
description: Downloads a file from File Archives to a Linux VM, unpacks it if it is a zip or tar file, and runs the installer in it (.sh, .rpm, .deb or an executable).

name: ServiceNow Request: Close
description: Closes the order's ServiceNow RITM complete or incomplete, attaches the CIs of the servers it produced as Affected CIs and as the RITM's configuration item, and links the created objects to the records.

name: Run CIT Tests
description: Starts a functionaltest job for the named CIT tests and returns its job id.

name: POC Onboarding: Configure Custom Server
description: Makes the shipped Custom Server blueprint orderable for the POC: recreates it when missing, activates it, enables every environment on its server tier, and sets a hostname template on the tier or on the listed environments.

name: Runbook Task Template (Linux)
description: Base bash script for Run Task: prints a summary of the Linux VM and an optional message, and shows the input, logging and error conventions to copy.

name: List Resources in Group
description: Lists the Azure resources in the resource group and records the count on the resource.

name: POC Onboarding: Install
description: Finishes the toolkit install after a sync or package import: sets Synchronous Action on the inline tools, enables every tool, checks outbound access to the Content Library and GitHub, and records the toolkit version.

name: POC Onboarding: Verify LDAP
description: Runs an LDAP utility's Verify Connection and returns the real bind or search error with a hint and the links to fix it.

name: POC Onboarding: SMTP Test
description: Sends a test email through the saved SMTP settings and returns the relay's real error with a hint when it fails.

name: Attach Data Disks from Disk Map
description: Adds the data disks in each provisioned server's disk_map parameter through its resource handler and records each disk's controller, SCSI address, and serial on data_disk_layout.

name: POC Onboarding: Import OS Build
description: Lists a handler's cached images for a location or imports one (AWS AMI, Azure marketplace image, vCenter template) into an OS build, reusing a build of the same name so one build spans handlers, refreshing an empty cache without the whitelist, and attaching the build to the environments.

name: Azure Network Security Group Sync
description: Discovers Azure network security groups across all Azure resource handlers.

name: POC Onboarding: Install Content Library Item
description: Lists a Content Library collection or downloads one item from content.cloudbolt.app and imports it the way the library page does, for UI extensions, recurring jobs, server and resource actions, rules and blueprints.

name: Node Size - Generate Options by Region, OS Image, Security, Networking and Storage (Azure SKU capabilities)
description: Generates node_size options filtered by live Azure SKU capabilities for the selected region, image, security, networking, and storage settings.

name: Azure PS (Deployment Script) - List Resource Groups
description: Lists the resource groups in the selected environment's Azure subscription whose names match a wildcard filter, run in Azure's deployment-script container.

name: Create Blob Container
description: Creates a blob container in the resource's Azure storage account.

name: Runbook Task Template (Windows)
description: Base PowerShell script for Run Task: prints a summary of the Windows VM and an optional message, and shows the input, logging and error conventions to copy.

name: Terraform Update
description: Updates any HCP Terraform workspace-per-deployment resource's variables from the built-in JSON dialog or a custom action form, then runs with a plan-approval pause.

name: Manage Blueprint Permissions
description: Lists, grants, or revokes a group's DEPLOY or MANAGE permission on a blueprint, so a repository sync's loss of group permissions can be snapshotted and restored.

name: Teardown OpenShift Project Landing Zone
description: Deletes the OpenShift project behind a landing zone and its CloudBolt environment once no managed servers remain.

name: Revoke Restricted Contributor Access
description: Removes the CloudBolt Restricted Contributor role from a user on the subscription.

name: POC Onboarding: Action Approval
description: Turns Requires approval on or off for a server or resource action, which the API cannot change, so a day-2 action pauses as an order for an approver.

name: Update Tags
description: Merges or replaces the tags on the Azure resource group.

name: ServiceNow Request: Open
description: Opens a ServiceNow REQ with one RITM for the order, through the generic catalog item when configured or the Table API otherwise, links the order item to both records, and at Post-Order Approval holds the order until ServiceNow approves.

name: Run Task
description: Runs the Remote Script chosen in the Run Task action on the selected VMs, after checking that it fits each VM and that its inputs are valid.

name: Run Azure PowerShell Script (Deployment Script)
description: Signs an Az PowerShell session in with the selected environment's Azure app registration via a short-lived access token and runs one of the blueprint's disabled Remote Scripts in a Microsoft-managed container through an ARM deployment script, with no Run on Server host.

name: Create AWS EKS Namespace
description: Creates a namespace landing zone on this cluster for a chosen CloudBolt group, filed as an AWS EKS Namespace resource with the same quota, policies, and pinned environment as an ordered one.

name: List Subscription Access
description: Lists role assignments at subscription scope with resolved principal names.

name: Run Installer from File Archive (Windows)
description: Downloads a file from File Archives to a Windows VM, unpacks it if it is a zip or tar file, and runs the installer in it (.msi, .ps1 or .exe).

name: Discover AWS EKS Namespaces
description: Imports namespaces labeled cloudbolt.io/landing-zone=true from every EKS cluster's orchestrator as AWS EKS Namespace resources.

name: Configure Data Disks (Oracle Linux)
description: Matches each attached data disk to its Linux disk by serial number, LUN, SCSI target, or attach order, then creates an LVM volume with an XFS file system and mounts it at the requested mount point.

name: Extend AWS EKS Namespace Expiration
description: Extends an EKS namespace landing zone's expiration date on the resource and the namespace annotation.

name: Configure Data Disks from Disk Map (Windows)
description: Formats the disks from a Windows server's disk_map in the guest: matches each one by serial number, SCSI address, or attach order, then initializes it GPT and formats it NTFS with its drive letter and label.

name: Delete Cluster
description: Deletes the EKS cluster's node groups, the cluster, its IAM cluster role, the CloudBolt container orchestrator, and the node group sub-resources, refusing while namespace landing zones remain on the cluster.

name: Azure PS (Deployment Script) - Tag Resource Group
description: Merges one tag onto a named resource group in the selected environment's Azure subscription and prints the resulting tags, run in Azure's deployment-script container.

name: Run Azure PowerShell Script
description: Signs an Az PowerShell session in with the selected environment's Azure app registration via a short-lived access token and runs one of the blueprint's disabled Remote Scripts on its Run on Server host.

name: Grant Restricted Contributor Access
description: Grants a user the CloudBolt Restricted Contributor role on the subscription.

name: OpenShift Project Landing Zone
description: Creates an OpenShift project with quota, limits, network policies, and an optional role binding, then pins a CloudBolt environment to it.

name: List AWS EKS Nodegroup
description: Syncs the cluster's managed node groups from AWS into CloudBolt sub-resources, creating missing ones and removing ones AWS no longer has.

name: HCP Terraform VM
description: Provisions a VM through HCP Terraform into a chosen CloudBolt environment's Azure subscription, in a dedicated workspace with a plan-approval pause before apply.

name: Run Recurring Job
description: Runs a recurring job immediately, like Run Now on the Recurring Jobs page.

name: Azure Storage Account
description: Creates an Azure storage account.

name: POC Onboarding: Trim Environment Order Form
description: Shortens an environment's order form for a POC by pinning infrastructure parameters to one value (which hides a required field) and removing the optional technology parameters, leaving the size, the NIC 1 networks chosen with onb_environment_networks and, where needed, the password; the report profile only lists the current form.

name: Add Resource Group to Environment
description: Adds the created resource group as a resource_group_arm option on the provisioning environment.

name: Compare Azure List Prices
description: Looks up Azure public list prices for any service across the regions of the Azure environments the caller can order into, with monthly estimates and hints for refining the search.

name: Update EKS Version
description: Upgrades the EKS cluster's Kubernetes control plane to the chosen version and waits for the update to finish.

name: POC Onboarding: LDAP Mapping
description: Maps an AD or LDAP group DN to a CloudBolt group with roles on an existing LDAP utility, so directory users land in the right group at first login.

name: POC Onboarding: Verify Resource Handler
description: Runs a resource handler's Verify Connection and returns the real exception text with a technology-specific hint, the minimum-permissions document and the handler's edit and verify links, recording the result for the status tool.

name: Manage Delete Lock
description: Applies or releases a CanNotDelete or ReadOnly management lock on the Azure resource group.

name: Attach Data Disks (Linux)
description: Adds one virtual disk per row of the order form's Data Disks table to each Linux server and records on its data_disk_layout parameter what the guest uses to find each disk, through the per-handler providers in the data_disk_mapping shared module.

name: Change Access Tier
description: Changes the default blob access tier of the Azure storage account.

name: Teardown Bicep Deployment
description: Deletes the Azure deployment stack behind the resource and the resources it manages.

name: Azure NSG - Attach VM to NSG
description: Attaches a provisioned Azure VM's network interfaces to the network security group in its azure_nsg field.

name: Launch Helm Chart (2)
description: Runs helm install on the resource's server tagged controller.

name: Add Parent Blueprints to Group
description: Grants a newly created group explicit deploy permission on every blueprint that one of its ancestor groups is explicitly permitted to deploy.

name: Deploy EKS Cluster
description: Creates an Amazon EKS cluster and its IAM cluster role in the chosen AWS environment, registers it as a CloudBolt Kubernetes container orchestrator, and stores the cluster details on the resource.

name: POC Hello World (Windows)
description: Prints a hello message, the computer name and the user inside a Windows guest to prove agentless script execution.

name: AWS EKS Namespace
description: Creates a namespace on an existing EKS cluster with a tiered ResourceQuota, LimitRange, and default-deny NetworkPolicies, then pins a CloudBolt environment to it and entitles the ordering group.

name: Request Quota Change
description: Moves a landing-zone project to a different size tier and mirrors the new quota into its environment.

name: Retrieve Pending Certificate

name: Install Windows File Server
description: Installs the File Server role on a Windows server.

name: Azure Resource Manager Rate Hook
description: Computes an Azure VM's rate from negotiated Price Sheet prices, falling back to the public Retail Prices API.

name: Azure CMK - Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
description: Creates a per-VM Key Vault key and disk encryption set and re-encrypts a provisioned Azure VM's disks with it.

name: Remove Resource Group from Environments
description: Removes the deleted resource group's resource_group_arm option from environments on the same subscription.

name: Azure NSG - Generate Options
description: Generates azure_nsg options from the network security groups in the selected environment's subscription and region.

name: POC Echo
description: Returns the posted JSON or query fields with the calling user and the time, proving a synchronous authenticated call into CloudBolt.

name: ServiceNow Request: Close on Denial
description: Closes the order's ServiceNow RITM as incomplete when a CloudBolt approver denies the order.

name: Test Postgres Connection
description: Tests the connection to the PostgreSQL database.

name: Scale AWS EKS Nodegroup
description: Changes a managed node group's minimum, maximum, and desired node counts, waits for AWS to apply them, and refreshes the node group sub-resource.

name: Ansible Ad-Hoc
description: Runs an Ansible playbook against the resource and stores the playbook's stats as resource fields.

name: Aria Migration Form Options
description: Serves the dropdown options for the Aria migration order form: Aria projects, an Aria cloud template's resources, a CloudBolt blueprint's tiers, and CloudBolt groups.

name: Generate Tags from Resource Handler Tag Map
description: Evaluates the resource handler's tag map against order and resource parameters and stores the result in cb_generated_tags.

name: Delete Blob Container
description: Deletes a blob container from the resource's Azure storage account.

name: POC Onboarding: Failure Trace
description: Walks an order or job down to the jobs that actually failed and returns their errors, output, progress tail, failed children and a hint for the common provisioning failures, naming the job id to pass to fetch_job_log for the traceback.

name: Teardown HCP Terraform No-Code Module
description: Destroys the HCP Terraform workspace behind a no-code deployment with a destroy run and a safe workspace delete.

name: Create Environment
description: Creates a CloudBolt environment on an AWS handler with the region and VPC stored as custom field values.

name: POC Onboarding: CIT Test from Order

name: POC Onboarding: Scorecard
description: Builds the POC test plan scorecard from the recorded item statuses and live evidence on the appliance (orders, handlers, environments, groups, mappings, actions, jobs), per category with weights.

description: Azure VM pricing engine that reads negotiated Price Sheet prices and falls back to the Retail Prices API.

name: disk_map
description: Parses and validates a server's disk_map parameter for its operating system and runs the in-guest data disk scripts of the disk map orchestration actions.

name: vm_adoption
description: Adopts the VMs a Terraform deployment created (from its cloudbolt_vm_ids output) as CloudBolt Server records under the resource, hydrated through the Azure, AWS, or VMware handler, and retires them on teardown.

name: bicep_engine
description: Bicep compiler bootstrap, parameter validation, deployment-stack client, and what-if approval engine.

name: ldap_dns
description: AD-integrated DNS A-record management over LDAPS, including MS-DNSP record encoding and ownership-verified deletes.

name: github
description: GitHub API client that authenticates with the GitHub ConnectionInfo when one is usable and otherwise fetches public repositories anonymously, with directory listing, raw file download, and archive fetch.

name: ad_domain
description: Finds the Active Directory domain and LDAP Utility for a server from its domain_ou or domain_to_join, binds with that utility, and finds and deletes computer objects.

name: azure_management_locks
description: REST helpers for Azure Resource Manager management locks, authenticated as a CloudBolt Azure resource handler.

name: data_disk_mapping
description: Adds data disks to a server through its resource handler and records, per handler (vCenter, Azure, Nutanix AHV), the serial and SCSI address the guest uses to find each disk.

name: tfc_api
description: HCP Terraform REST client and run engine for workspace-per-deployment provisioning.

name: windows_ca
description: Certificate enrollment client for Microsoft AD CS Web Enrollment, with key and CSR generation.

name: runbook_workflows
description: Stores workflows, works out which workflows and step actions fit a VM or a workflow's filters, builds the run form's prompts, and runs a workflow's steps in order with outputs passed between them.

name: openshift_landing_zone
description: OpenShift REST client, size-tier catalog, and environment helpers for the landing-zone blueprint.

name: env_options
description: RBAC-gated option sources (resource groups, subnets, images, sizes, any custom field) derived from a CloudBolt Environment for order-form dropdowns and build plugins.

name: eks_namespace
description: Kubernetes API client on the EKS cluster's orchestrator, size-tier catalog, and cluster lookups for the AWS EKS Namespace blueprint.

name: aria_connection
description: Aria Automation 8 and Aria Orchestrator REST clients built on a CloudBolt ConnectionInfo labeled vra8 or aria, with generate-options helpers for connection and project dropdowns.

name: file_archives
description: Stores versioned files on the CloudBolt appliance, signs short-lived download links for them, and adds the download step to scripts that declare files with cb-archive header lines.

name: azure_disk_encryption
description: Per-VM customer-managed-key disk encryption helpers for Azure Key Vault and disk encryption sets.

name: servicenow_requests
description: ServiceNow REQ/RITM client plus the order-summary, catalog-variable, and identifier-storage helpers shared by the ServiceNow request actions.

name: Runbook Tasks
description: Endpoint the Run Task form calls for the tasks that fit a VM, a chosen task's inputs, and to save credentials on a VM that has none.

name: POC Echo
description: Endpoint that returns the posted JSON with the calling user and the time, so an external system can prove a synchronous authenticated call into CloudBolt.

name: Azure PS Script Panel
description: GET endpoint the Run an Azure PowerShell Script order form calls to fetch the SurveyJS fields for the chosen catalog script's declared action inputs.

name: Runbook Workflows
description: Endpoint the Run Workflow form calls for the workflows that fit a VM, a chosen workflow's steps and prompts, and to save credentials on a VM that has none.

name: Aria Migration Form Options
description: GET endpoint the Aria migration order form calls to list Aria projects, an Aria cloud template's resources, a CloudBolt blueprint's tiers, and CloudBolt groups.

name: Form Options
description: GET endpoint that custom forms call to fill dropdowns from a CloudBolt Environment (resource groups, subnets, images, sizes, any custom field), from an HCP Terraform no-code module's variable options, or to build a deployed resource's Terraform Update variables panel.
